correctness.rationale: With all off-diagonal arcs present and diagonal feedback 0 on U, 1 on L, the update F=D+J and char2 determinant lemma give chi_F=X^(b-1)(X+1)^(a-1)[X^2+(1+a_bar+b_bar)X+b_bar]. Direct kernel counts dim ker(F)=b-1 and dim ker(F)^2=b-1 if b odd, b if even, with corresponding F+I counts a-1 and a-1/a. Combined multiplicities force precisely the four Jordan decompositions: (odd,odd) order-3 C(X²+X+1), (odd,even) nilpotent J3(0), (even,odd) unipotent J3(1), (even,even) J2 at both 0 and 1. Fitting decomposition gives periods {1,3},{1},{1,2,4},{1,2}, sharp transient maxima 1,3,1,2, primitive orbit counts and exact H_t table for every q=2^k. Independently traversed 3600 labeled binary states for all 16 pairs 2<=a,b<=5; all cycle and entry-time counts matched. The analytic block proof, not finite enumeration or stored execution log, supplies all-parameter q,n results.
